definitions.explanation: The identifying number or code of a scheduled transport service, most commonly an airline flight (e.g., JL123, NH456). Can also refer to bus or ferry service numbers, though airline usage is dominant.

examples.japanese: {便名|びんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the flight number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{搭乗券|とうじょうけん}→搭乗券：17977_toujouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{便名|びんめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{出発時刻|しゅっぱつじこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてあります→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The flight number and departure time are written on the boarding pass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電光掲示板|でんこうけいじばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{便名|びんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the flight number on the electronic board in the arrivals lobby.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ (service, flight — as in a scheduled transport run) and {名|めい} (name, designation). The word ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ itself is a useful counter/noun for scheduled services: {一便|いちびん} (first flight/service), {最終便|さいしゅうびん} (last flight/service).

This is essential vocabulary for anyone traveling by air in Japan. You will see {便名|びんめい} on booking confirmations, boarding passes, airport information boards, and immigration forms. When picking someone up from the airport, asking for the {便名|びんめい} is the standard way to track their arrival.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {便名|びんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm the flight number
- {便名|びんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧: to enter the flight number
- {便名|びんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to search by flight number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フライトナンバー: flight number — the English loanword equivalent; less common in formal Japanese contexts
- ⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧: flight, service — the broader term for a scheduled transport run
- ⟦{航空便|こうくうびん}→航空便：24353_koukuubin⟧: airmail; air service — refers to the service itself rather than its identifying number
